purpose: Enforced, deterministic source-quality floors layered on top of the measure-only coverage baseline. This first floor bounds unsafe TypeScript suppressions in the source bucket. It is behavior-neutral at introduction (the codebase currently ships zero unsafe suppressions in source) and blocks future regressions.
scope: source bucket only — files classified 'source' by the coverage-baseline classifier (**/src/**/*.{ts,mts,cts}); test, generated (dist/build-info), archive, and non-src 'other' files are excluded.
ratchetContract: Floors only ever ratchet downward. The guard requires measured == max: raising max is allowed only when a new suppression is genuinely unavoidable and must carry a one-line justification; removing suppressions requires lowering max in the same PR so the surface cannot silently regrow.

unsafeSuppressions.definition: A suppression that silences a diagnostic without proof it is still needed: @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, a bare @ts-expect-error (no inline explanation), or any eslint-disable* directive (dead — the repo ships no ESLint config). @ts-expect-error WITH an inline explanation is the safe form and is intentionally allowed.
unsafeSuppressions.note: First enforced source-quality floor for #1506. Coverage floors for lifecycle/policy/evidence/provenance modules land in a later wave on top of the existing coverage baseline; live coverage is measured but not yet a gate because it is non-deterministic under the broker manifest test runner.
